# Taste Design Suite
Canonical source: `Leonxlnx/taste-skill` → `skills` on `main`.

This is an umbrella router. After synchronization, select the smallest relevant child skill under `upstream/`; do not load the entire pack unless required. Current canonical children include `minimalist-skill`, `brutalist-skill`, `brandkit`, `redesign-skill`, `image-to-code-skill`, `imagegen-frontend-web`, `imagegen-frontend-mobile`, `stitch-skill`, and Taste-specific skills.

Imported aesthetic guidance remains subordinate to project requirements, Creator authority, accessibility, and LeeWay verification rules.

State while `upstream/` is absent: `REMOTE_CANONICAL`.
